info.name: Mirakl Connect Channel Platform APIs Carriers Picklists API

params.name: pickup_date_min
params.description: Filter picklists with a pick-up date after the given date.

params.name: pickup_date_max
params.description: Filter picklists with a pick-up date before the given date.

params.name: picklist_id
params.description: Picklist id for filtering. This parameter can be supplied multiple times (picklist_id=OR01-A&picklist_id=OR02-A...).

params.name: picklist_state
params.description: Picklist state for filtering. This parameter can be supplied multiple times (picklist_state=WAITING_PREPARATION&picklist_state=IN_PREPARATION...).

params.name: order_line_id
params.description: Order line id for filtering. This parameter can be supplied multiple times (order_line_id=OR01-A-1&order_line_id=OR02-A-1...).
